elevation.note: Identified from embedded SRTM metadata; original download URL unavailable
elevation.processing: GDAL Translate cropped the original grid to the Seattle study area without resampling; the QGIS project displays it with a continuous five-stop color ramp
elevation.display_note: Values below 0 use the lowest color; source values are unchanged

parks.attribution: City of Seattle, Seattle Parks and Recreation
parks.note: Points are park boundary centroids, not entrances or measured elevation locations; PMA is the property management area identifier
parks.elevation_m: Nearest source raster cell at each centroid, in meters; derived from SRTM rather than a field measurement at the park

export.tool: QMetaTiles 1.5 TileSet.run using the saved QGIS raster renderer
export.png_compression: Lossless PNG compression using Qt quality 0
